_readme: BytePlus ModelArk publishes a Seedream 5.0 Pro tutorial and serves its documentation
through client-side rendering, so every request returned navigation and no content.
Everything below is therefore one provider's account of the model.

capabilities.claim: Input images for multi-image fusion and reference-guided editing.

capabilities.note: Far wider than GPT Image 2's 3:1, which is the one place this model clearly wins.
